entry.title: New: RES23-258 (Honolulu) — CCL
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF TRAVEL, LODGING, REGISTRATION FEE AND MEALS VALUED AT $2,186 TO THE CITY FROM NATIONAL LEAGUE OF CITIES (NLC) FOR THE DATA SPECIALIST OF THE OFFICE OF ECONOMIC REVITALIZATION TO ATTEND THE 2023 NATIONAL LEAGUE OF CITIES SUMMIT IN ATLANTA, GEORGIA FROM NOVEMBER 15-18, 2023.
